facts.fact: Angola Telecom's operations executive Rock Dinis said the first link of the national fibre-optic broadband backbone, DWDM-based and built with Mercury, was inaugurated at Lobito on a route from Luanda through Bengo and Cuanza Sul to Benguela, with initial capacity reported as 200 Gigabytes; the project is meant to reach all 21 provinces, Huambo, Namibe and Cabinda being next (plan only).
